sources: docs/ops/DOE-FAMILY.md + docs/ops/DOE-TAXONOMY.md + experiments/doe/*/DESIGN.json + experiments/doe/*/records/*.json + experiments/doe/*/SUMMARY.json (family campaigns — DoE-owned records)
honesty_rules: Show only what the record holds; a value the record does not hold renders as absent, never synthesized.
Defined-but-not-run experiments render as exactly that.
Weights and scores are read from the code and records at collection time, never transcribed from prose claims.
Workflow run counts are API observations stamped with their read time, not live claims.

methods_library.file: deepcli/deepcli/observatory/doe.py — DoE helpers for MVT campaigns

functions.name: full_factorial
functions.doc: All combinations of factor levels. 2^k growth; use only for small k.

functions.name: taguchi_l9
functions.doc: L9 orthogonal array for up to 4 factors at 3 levels each.

functions.name: mvt_shuffle
functions.doc: Randomized assignment for multi-variate testing. Duplicates allowed.

skill.factor_space: provider x model x prompt x manager x cohort x sequencing (default agent-team factor space; extendable with task family, scope/ref, tool policy, context budget, concurrency, validation and recovery policy)
design_rules: State the hypothesis before running treatments.
Define factor levels explicitly and preserve their provenance.
Separate the same-task treatment from adversarial/reviewer prompt variants.
Randomize or rotate treatment order where ordering can confound results.
Preserve a stable cohort/ref so code changes do not masquerade as model effects.
Record manager/policy version independently from provider/model identity.
Do not use latency as a correctness proxy.
Record resource/quota state as a capacity variable, not a quality score.
Preserve negative, skipped, unavailable, and censored observations.
Avoid p-hacking: do not select a design or metric after seeing the result.
If the design changes midstream, create a new cohort/version and retain the prior ledger.

first_factorial_slice.source: docs/ops/ATES-ORCHESTRATOR-DOE-MVT.md — an experiment arm varies declared factors while task contract hash, environment fingerprint, benchmark version and deterministic scorer remain fixed
first_factorial_slice.executor: ATES harness — this slice is the §DoE design inside the ATES doc; arms designed here execute under the ATES invariants and are recorded on the MVT surface.

dspy_lane.note: Consideration/optimization lane (MSM-004 design): DSPy arms feed the APPROX-006 A/B/C/D cohort entry; optimizer artifacts never silently mutate production routing weights and stay on the dual-gate promotion path. The design doc records the runtime extract as a later PR — the lane is defined, not run.

executed_comparisons.record: docs/proposals/passes/strands-rfp-response/cycle/IMPLEMENTATION.json — the Delphi Oracle Method cycle's implementation parallel-comparisons: the same suite discipline applied per candidate, on an equalized evidence base
executed_comparisons.note: REQUIRED on this surface (owner ruling, 2026-10-27): the repo's one executed per-candidate comparison, presented with its full payload and labeled as a Delphi record — it is also rendered on the Oracle Panel. It is not a standalone DoE campaign, and DoE claims no campaign results from it.

citations.label: Delphi Oracle Method cycle — implementation round
citations.note: Owner of the executed comparison presented above under executed_comparisons; the Delphi surface's home rendering is the Oracle Panel.

family.statement: DoE is a family; MVT is one member, not the whole.

shared.experiment_record_schema: docs/ops/corpus/EXPERIMENT.schema.json — DOE/MVT Experiment Record v1.0 (primary home: MVT surface; family campaigns emit records conforming to it)
shared.intake_rule: A campaign joins the family only with a committed design record + run evidence (EXPERIMENT-conforming records). Proposals alone do not count.
shared.evaluation_doctrine: Parallel lanes under a shared capability contract; scoring separates execution status, task outcome, correctness, integration, regression, resource cost; cherry-pick customizations are recorded as a new cohort/version, never folded silently into a running design.

members.note: Existing member. Its payload lives on the MVT surface (mvt-feed.json); this surface carries the pointer only, per the separation spec.

members.design_type: blocked full factorial (2x2), generated by deepcli.observatory.doe.full_factorial
members.primary_outcome: source-grounded task accuracy = required fragments recovered / required fragments

members.note: Proposal filed (#1850); no committed design record and no run evidence, so under the intake rule it is not yet a family member and claims no results.

Design classes per docs/ops/DOE-TAXONOMY.md. Implemented generators: full factorial (full_factorial), Taguchi L9 fractional orthogonal array (taguchi_l9). Skill-named, no generator: fractional factorial, Plackett-Burman, sequential/adaptive. Candidates: foldover, central composite, Box-Behnken, RSM, mixture, split-plot, Latin hypercube. mvt_shuffle is an assignment mechanism, not a design class.
